## Interfaces

### QueryAssistantOptions

Defined in: [server/src/ai-assistant/ai-assistant.ts:20](https://github.com/josedab/reactivebase/blob/deadc852d0d384e5f93668842c410b98d14c81d8/packages/server/src/ai-assistant/ai-assistant.ts#L20)

AI Query Assistant & Schema Copilot.
Natural language to ReactiveBase query conversion, schema optimization
suggestions, and conversational debugging.

Features:
  - Natural language → typed query code generation
  - Schema optimization suggestions based on access patterns
  - Query explanation and debugging assistance
  - Works with any AI provider (OpenAI, Ollama, etc.)

Usage:
  const assistant = new QueryAssistant({ schema, provider: openaiProvider })
  const result = assistant.generateQuery("find overdue tasks for team alpha")
  const suggestions = assistant.suggestOptimizations(queryStats)

Defined in: [server/src/api-gen/openapi-generator.ts:14](https://github.com/josedab/reactivebase/blob/deadc852d0d384e5f93668842c410b98d14c81d8/packages/server/src/api-gen/openapi-generator.ts#L14)

OpenAPI 3.1 spec generator for ReactiveBase.
Generates OpenAPI specs from registered query/mutation/action function descriptors,
with auto-generated schemas, security schemes, and documentation pages.

Usage:
  const generator = new OpenApiGenerator({ title: "My API" })
  const spec = generator.generateSpec(functions)
  const html = generator.generateSwaggerUIHTML(spec)

### PermissionSchema

Defined in: [server/src/authz/authz.ts:23](https://github.com/josedab/reactivebase/blob/deadc852d0d384e5f93668842c410b98d14c81d8/packages/server/src/authz/authz.ts#L23)

Declarative Authorization Language for ReactiveBase.
Inspired by Google Zanzibar / Oso / AuthZed.

Define permissions as relations between entities:
  definePermissions({
    document: {
      relations: { owner: "user", editor: "user", viewer: "user", org: "organization" },
      permissions: {
        view: ["owner", "editor", "viewer", or("org.member")],
        edit: ["owner", "editor"],
        delete: ["owner"],
      },
    },
  })

Evaluate:
  await ctx.auth.can("edit", "document", docId)

#### Indexable

\[`resourceType`: `string`\]: [`ResourceDefinition`](server%20-%20Core%20server%20framework%20for%20reactive%20backends%20on%20Postgres.md#resourcedefinition)

### DatabaseBranchingOptions

Defined in: [server/src/branching/branching.ts:19](https://github.com/josedab/reactivebase/blob/deadc852d0d384e5f93668842c410b98d14c81d8/packages/server/src/branching/branching.ts#L19)

Database Branching & Preview Environments for ReactiveBase.
Create isolated database branches for feature development and PR previews.

Strategies:
  - Local: Schema-level isolation within the same Postgres instance
  - Cloud: Neon's branching API for copy-on-write forks
  - GitHub: CI integration with GitHub Action for PR-linked environments

Usage:
  const branching = new DatabaseBranching({ strategy: "schema" })
  const branch = await branching.createBranch("feature-x", { fromBranch: "main" })
  await branching.switchBranch("feature-x")
  await branching.mergeBranch("feature-x", "main")

Neon Branching API integration for ReactiveBase.
Provides copy-on-write database branching via Neon's platform API.

Usage:
  const adapter = new NeonBranchingAdapter({ apiKey: "neon_key", projectId: "proj_123" })
  const branch = await adapter.createBranch("proj_123", "feature-x")
  const connStr = await adapter.getConnectionString("proj_123", branch.id)

### CloudObservabilityOptions

Defined in: [server/src/cloud-platform/cloud-observability.ts:22](https://github.com/josedab/reactivebase/blob/deadc852d0d384e5f93668842c410b98d14c81d8/packages/server/src/cloud-platform/cloud-observability.ts#L22)

Cloud Observability Dashboard for ReactiveBase Cloud.
Provides real-time monitoring, metrics aggregation, alerting,
and a self-contained HTML dashboard for cloud deployments.

Features:
  - Real-time subscription and query metrics
  - Auto-scaling metrics and recommendations
  - Health check monitoring with uptime tracking
  - Alert rules with webhook notifications
  - Infrastructure cost monitoring
  - One-click TLS certificate status

Usage:
  const observability = new CloudObservability({ projectId: "proj_1" })
  observability.recordMetric("query_latency_ms", 45)
  const dashboard = observability.generateDashboardHTML()

### CloudPlatformOptions

Defined in: [server/src/cloud-platform/cloud-platform.ts:15](https://github.com/josedab/reactivebase/blob/deadc852d0d384e5f93668842c410b98d14c81d8/packages/server/src/cloud-platform/cloud-platform.ts#L15)

ReactiveBase Cloud Platform — Managed Cloud Control Plane.
Provides project management, environment provisioning, deployment pipeline,
team collaboration, and usage-based billing APIs.

Usage:
  const platform = new CloudPlatform({ region: "us-east-1" })
  const project = await platform.createProject({ name: "my-app", plan: "starter" })
  const env = await platform.createEnvironment(project.id, { name: "staging" })
  await platform.deploy(project.id, env.id, { source: "git", ref: "main" })

ReactiveBase Cloud client.
Handles project creation, deployment, and management for the managed cloud offering.

Features:
  - Project provisioning with multi-region support
  - Environment management (production, staging, preview)
  - Team & API key management
  - Deployment pipeline with rollback
  - Usage metering and billing
  - Log streaming and metrics

### RpcFunctionDef

Defined in: [server/src/codegen/rpc-types.ts:21](https://github.com/josedab/reactivebase/blob/deadc852d0d384e5f93668842c410b98d14c81d8/packages/server/src/codegen/rpc-types.ts#L21)

Enhanced RPC Type Generation — Zod-like runtime validation that
doubles as TypeScript types, plus zero-config function reference
generation with full IntelliSense support.

Features:
  - Runtime validation schemas that infer TypeScript types
  - Function reference generation with args/return types
  - Validation middleware auto-generation
  - Client SDK type generation for multi-language support
  - Incremental codegen with file hash tracking

Usage:
  const rpc = new RpcTypeGenerator()
  rpc.addFunction("tasks.list", "query", taskListSchema, taskListReturn)
  const output = rpc.generate()

### TypedFunctionInfo

Defined in: [server/src/codegen/typed-codegen.ts:17](https://github.com/josedab/reactivebase/blob/deadc852d0d384e5f93668842c410b98d14c81d8/packages/server/src/codegen/typed-codegen.ts#L17)

Enhanced TypeScript SDK Codegen.
Extends the base codegen with:
  - AST-based type extraction from function signatures
  - Schema-driven typed database accessors
  - Watch mode for incremental regeneration
  - Full typed API module with argument and return type inference

Usage:
  const codegen = new TypedCodegen({ functionsDir: "./convex" })
  const result = codegen.scanAndGenerate()
  codegen.startWatch(onChange)

### CursorPosition

Defined in: [server/src/collaboration/collaboration.ts:16](https://github.com/josedab/reactivebase/blob/deadc852d0d384e5f93668842c410b98d14c81d8/packages/server/src/collaboration/collaboration.ts#L16)

Live Collaboration Primitives for ReactiveBase.
Drop-in collaboration kit: cursors, selection awareness, typing indicators,
and avatar stacks — built on the existing presence and CRDT modules.

Usage:
  const collab = new CollaborationManager({ ttl: 30000 })
  collab.updateCursor("room-1", "conn-1", { x: 100, y: 200, userId: "alice" })
  collab.updateSelection("room-1", "conn-1", { start: 0, end: 10, field: "title" })
  collab.setTyping("room-1", "conn-1", true)
  collab.onAwarenessChange("room-1", (state) => broadcastToClients(state))

### StateVector

Defined in: [server/src/collaboration/yjs-protocol.ts:23](https://github.com/josedab/reactivebase/blob/deadc852d0d384e5f93668842c410b98d14c81d8/packages/server/src/collaboration/yjs-protocol.ts#L23)

Yjs-Compatible Binary Protocol for ReactiveBase Document Collaboration.

Implements a subset of the Yjs binary sync protocol:
  - State vector encoding/decoding (for efficient sync)
  - Update message encoding/decoding
  - Awareness protocol messages
  - Document state merging with clock-based ordering
  - Binary diff computation for minimal network transfer

This module can interop with actual Yjs clients — the binary format is
compatible with Y.encodeStateVector() and Y.encodeStateAsUpdate().

Usage:
  const sv = encodeStateVector({ client1: 5, client2: 3 })
  const update = encodeUpdate(clientId, clock, content)
  const merged = mergeUpdates([update1, update2])
  const diff = computeStateDiff(localSV, remoteUpdates)

#### Indexable

\[`clientId`: `string`\]: `number`

***

Defined in: [server/src/embedded/embedded.ts:12](https://github.com/josedab/reactivebase/blob/deadc852d0d384e5f93668842c410b98d14c81d8/packages/server/src/embedded/embedded.ts#L12)

Embedded Postgres adapter for zero-dependency local development.
Wraps PGlite (WebAssembly Postgres) to satisfy the pg.Pool interface.

Usage:
  import { createEmbeddedPool } from "@reactivebase/server/embedded"
  const pool = await createEmbeddedPool({ dataDir: ".reactivebase/data" })

PGlite must be installed separately: npm install @electric-sql/pglite

Compliance Toolkit — PII detection, audit trail, GDPR erasure,
and compliance documentation generation.

Usage:
  const compliance = new ComplianceToolkit()
  const pii = compliance.detectPII(schemaFields)
  compliance.recordAccess(userId, "tasks", "read", rowIds)
  const doc = compliance.generateComplianceReport()
  await compliance.eraseUserData(userId)

### AnalyticsMetricDef

Defined in: [server/src/materialized-views/analytics-engine.ts:15](https://github.com/josedab/reactivebase/blob/deadc852d0d384e5f93668842c410b98d14c81d8/packages/server/src/materialized-views/analytics-engine.ts#L15)

Real-Time Analytics Engine.
Declarative analytics DSL with IVM-backed incremental computation
and reactive subscriptions for live dashboards.

Usage:
  const engine = new AnalyticsEngine()
  engine.defineMetric({ name: "daily_signups", table: "users", aggregation: "count", timeBucket: "day" })
  engine.applyChange({ table: "users", operation: "insert", row: { id: "u1" } })
  const result = engine.query("daily_signups", { from: startOfDay, to: now })

### MaterializedViewDefinition

Defined in: [server/src/materialized-views/materialized-views.ts:20](https://github.com/josedab/reactivebase/blob/deadc852d0d384e5f93668842c410b98d14c81d8/packages/server/src/materialized-views/materialized-views.ts#L20)

Reactive Analytics & Materialized Views for ReactiveBase.
Define reactive materialized views that incrementally update when underlying data changes.

Usage:
  const taskStats = defineMaterializedView({
    name: "task_stats_by_team",
    source: "tasks",
    groupBy: ["team_id"],
    aggregations: {
      total: { fn: "count", field: "*" },
      completed: { fn: "count", field: "*", filter: { done: true } },
    },
    refreshStrategy: "on-mutation",
  })

### ProfilerOptions

Defined in: [server/src/metrics/performance-profiler.ts:21](https://github.com/josedab/reactivebase/blob/deadc852d0d384e5f93668842c410b98d14c81d8/packages/server/src/metrics/performance-profiler.ts#L21)

Performance Profiler & Observability Engine.
Extends the MetricsCollector with:
  - Slow query detection with configurable thresholds
  - N+1 query pattern detection
  - Query execution plan profiling
  - Subscription fan-out analysis
  - Grafana dashboard JSON generation
  - Datadog/New Relic exporter stubs
  - Alert rules configuration

Usage:
  const profiler = new PerformanceProfiler({ slowQueryThresholdMs: 100 })
  profiler.recordQueryExecution("tasks.list", 250, ["tasks", "users"])
  const alerts = profiler.checkAlerts()
  const grafana = profiler.generateGrafanaDashboard()

### ProjectAnalysis

Defined in: [server/src/migrate-from/migration-wizard.ts:23](https://github.com/josedab/reactivebase/blob/deadc852d0d384e5f93668842c410b98d14c81d8/packages/server/src/migrate-from/migration-wizard.ts#L23)

Enhanced Migration Wizard for Prisma and Drizzle.
Provides incremental migration, diff preview, API route conversion,
and interactive migration planning.

Features:
  - Analyze existing Prisma/Drizzle project structure
  - Generate ReactiveBase schema with diff preview
  - Convert tRPC/Express API routes to query/mutation skeletons
  - Incremental migration support (one table at a time)
  - Migration plan with rollback support
  - Compatibility report showing feature gaps

Usage:
  const wizard = new MigrationWizard()
  const analysis = wizard.analyzeProject(projectFiles)
  const plan = wizard.createMigrationPlan(analysis)
  const output = wizard.executePlan(plan)

### MigrationSchemaChange

Defined in: [server/src/migrations/migration-planner.ts:18](https://github.com/josedab/reactivebase/blob/deadc852d0d384e5f93668842c410b98d14c81d8/packages/server/src/migrations/migration-planner.ts#L18)

Zero-Downtime Migration Planner.
Analyzes schema diffs and generates safe migration strategies:
  - Breaking change detection (safe / caution / breaking)
  - Expand-contract pattern generation for breaking changes
  - Concurrent index creation for zero-lock migrations
  - Client compatibility checking
  - Migration dry-run simulation

Usage:
  const planner = new MigrationPlanner()
  const analysis = planner.analyzeChanges(oldSchema, newSchema)
  const plan = planner.generateSafePlan(analysis)

### DatabaseAdapter

Defined in: [server/src/multi-db/database-adapter.ts:16](https://github.com/josedab/reactivebase/blob/deadc852d0d384e5f93668842c410b98d14c81d8/packages/server/src/multi-db/database-adapter.ts#L16)

Multi-Database Adapter Layer for ReactiveBase.
Abstracts the storage layer to support MySQL 8+ and SQLite (via libSQL/Turso)
in addition to Postgres.

Usage:
  const adapter = createPostgresAdapter({ connectionString: "..." })
  const result = await adapter.query("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?", [1])

  const sqlite = createSQLiteAdapter({ url: "file:local.db" })
  const mysql = createMySQLAdapter({ connectionString: "mysql://..." })

Multi-Database Federation for ReactiveBase.
Supports multiple named database connections with independent schemas,
migrations, and connection pools.

Usage:
  const federation = new DatabaseFederation({
    databases: {
      primary: { connectionString: process.env.PRIMARY_DB_URL, default: true },
      analytics: { connectionString: process.env.ANALYTICS_DB_URL },
      legacy: { connectionString: process.env.LEGACY_DB_URL, readOnly: true },
    },
  })

### PluginV2Definition

Defined in: [server/src/plugins/marketplace.ts:22](https://github.com/josedab/reactivebase/blob/deadc852d0d384e5f93668842c410b98d14c81d8/packages/server/src/plugins/marketplace.ts#L22)

Plugin Marketplace & Ecosystem v2.
Enhanced plugin SDK with lifecycle hooks, dependency management,
configuration schema validation, and a browsable plugin registry.

Features:
  - Plugin SDK v2 with install/start/stop lifecycle hooks
  - Configuration schema validation per plugin
  - Inter-plugin dependencies
  - Plugin versioning and compatibility checks
  - Searchable registry with categories and ratings
  - First-party plugin catalog expansion

Usage:
  const marketplace = new PluginMarketplace()
  marketplace.install(pluginDef, config)
  marketplace.start("plugin-name")

### EdgePrefetchOptions

Defined in: [server/src/reactivity/edge-prefetch.ts:15](https://github.com/josedab/reactivebase/blob/deadc852d0d384e5f93668842c410b98d14c81d8/packages/server/src/reactivity/edge-prefetch.ts#L15)

Edge Query Prefetch Cache.
CDN-edge query result caching with pub/sub invalidation.
First response from edge cache (<10ms), then live WebSocket for updates.

Usage:
  const cache = new EdgePrefetchCache({ ttlMs: 30000 })
  cache.set("tasks.list", { userId: "u1" }, results)
  const hit = cache.get("tasks.list", { userId: "u1" })
  cache.invalidate("tasks")  // Invalidate all queries touching "tasks" table

### RowLevelTrackerOptions

Defined in: [server/src/reactivity/row-level-tracker.ts:20](https://github.com/josedab/reactivebase/blob/deadc852d0d384e5f93668842c410b98d14c81d8/packages/server/src/reactivity/row-level-tracker.ts#L20)

Row-Level Reactive Subscriptions (Level 3).
Extends the filter-level invalidation with optional row-level tracking.

Features:
  - Track exact row IDs returned by queries
  - Bloom filter for memory-efficient row set storage
  - Precise invalidation: only re-execute when tracked rows change
  - Auto-fallback to filter-level when row count exceeds threshold
  - Configurable per-query via reactivity option

Usage:
  const tracker = new RowLevelTracker({ maxRowsPerSubscription: 10000 })
  tracker.trackResult(subscriptionId, ["row-1", "row-2", "row-3"])
  const shouldInvalidate = tracker.shouldInvalidate(subscriptionId, ["row-2"])

### SchemaDesignerOptions

Defined in: [server/src/schema-designer/schema-designer.ts:21](https://github.com/josedab/reactivebase/blob/deadc852d0d384e5f93668842c410b98d14c81d8/packages/server/src/schema-designer/schema-designer.ts#L21)

Visual Schema Designer & Migration Planner for ReactiveBase.
GUI tool for designing schemas visually, viewing entity relationships,
and planning migrations with impact analysis.

Features:
  - Entity-relationship diagram data model from defineSchema()
  - Interactive schema editing with code generation
  - Migration impact analysis showing affected queries/subscriptions
  - Self-contained HTML visualizer (works with React Flow or D3)

Usage:
  const designer = new SchemaDesigner({ schema })
  const model = designer.getERModel()
  const html = designer.generateVisualizerHTML()
  const impact = designer.analyzeImpact([{ type: "add_column", table: "tasks", ... }])

### SaasKitOptions

Defined in: [server/src/tenancy/saas-kit.ts:14](https://github.com/josedab/reactivebase/blob/deadc852d0d384e5f93668842c410b98d14c81d8/packages/server/src/tenancy/saas-kit.ts#L14)

Multi-Tenant SaaS Starter Kit.
Provides a complete tenant lifecycle manager with billing hooks,
tenant-aware subscriptions, onboarding flow, and admin overview.

Usage:
  const saas = new SaasKit({ billingProvider: stripe })
  const tenant = await saas.onboardTenant({ name: "Acme", plan: "pro" })
  saas.enforcePlanLimits(tenantId, "subscriptions", currentCount)

### TenantConnectionConfig

Defined in: [server/src/tenancy/tenant-routing.ts:14](https://github.com/josedab/reactivebase/blob/deadc852d0d384e5f93668842c410b98d14c81d8/packages/server/src/tenancy/tenant-routing.ts#L14)

Tenant-aware connection routing for ReactiveBase.
Routes database connections based on tenant isolation mode (row-level or schema-per-tenant).
Manages per-tenant connection pools with configurable sizes.

Usage:
  const router = new TenantConnectionRouter({ mode: "row", column: "tenant_id" })
  const conn = await router.getConnection("acme")
  conn.release()

### MutationEvent

Defined in: [server/src/time-travel/time-travel.ts:20](https://github.com/josedab/reactivebase/blob/deadc852d0d384e5f93668842c410b98d14c81d8/packages/server/src/time-travel/time-travel.ts#L20)

Time-Travel Debugging for ReactiveBase.
Records mutation history with full transaction snapshots, enabling
query replay against any historical point in time.

Features:
  - Append-only event store for mutation history
  - Query replay against historical state via asOf()
  - Diff viewer between two points in time
  - Configurable retention with automatic pruning

Usage:
  const tt = new TimeTravelEngine({ retentionDays: 7 })
  tt.recordMutation({ table, operation, before, after })
  const snapshot = tt.getSnapshotAt(timestamp)

> **id**: `string`

### TypeManifest

Defined in: [server/src/type-bridge/type-bridge.ts:22](https://github.com/josedab/reactivebase/blob/deadc852d0d384e5f93668842c410b98d14c81d8/packages/server/src/type-bridge/type-bridge.ts#L22)

End-to-End Type Safety Bridge for ReactiveBase.
Provides full type inference from server function definitions to client hooks
without requiring a separate codegen step for most use cases.

Key concepts:
  - TypeManifest: JSON descriptor of all function signatures
  - FunctionSignature: Typed descriptor for a single query/mutation/action
  - TypeBridge: Utilities to generate and consume type manifests

Usage:
  // Server-side: generate manifest from scanned functions
  const manifest = TypeBridge.generateManifest(scannedFunctions, schema)

  // Client-side: TypeScript infers types from the manifest
  const api = createTypedApi<typeof manifest>()
  useQuery(api.tasks.list) // Return type inferred as Task[]

### DaclAction

> **DaclAction**: `"read"` \| `"write"` \| `"create"` \| `"update"` \| `"delete"` \| `"*"`

Defined in: [server/src/dacl/dacl.ts:19](https://github.com/josedab/reactivebase/blob/deadc852d0d384e5f93668842c410b98d14c81d8/packages/server/src/dacl/dacl.ts#L19)

Declarative Access Control Language (DACL) for ReactiveBase.
Domain-specific language for access control that compiles to both
Postgres RLS policies and server-side middleware.

Usage:
  const dacl = new DaclEngine()
  dacl.definePolicy(
    allow("tasks", "read").where((ctx) => ctx.user.teamId === ctx.row.teamId)
  )
  dacl.definePolicy(
    allow("tasks", "write").roles("admin", "editor")
  )
  const result = await dacl.check({ userId: "u1", action: "read", resource: "tasks", row: { teamId: "t1" } })

Defined in: [server/src/ivm/ivm.ts:24](https://github.com/josedab/reactivebase/blob/deadc852d0d384e5f93668842c410b98d14c81d8/packages/server/src/ivm/ivm.ts#L24)

Incremental View Maintenance (IVM) for ReactiveBase.
Instead of re-executing entire queries on data change, computes only the delta
and patches the cached result. Uses dependency DAGs to propagate changes
through filters, joins, and aggregations.

Usage:
  const ivm = new IncrementalViewMaintainer()
  const view = ivm.register({
    viewId: "v1",
    queryAst: { type: "scan", table: "tasks", filter: { done: false } },
    currentResult: [...tasks],
  })
  const delta = ivm.applyChange({
    table: "tasks",
    type: "insert",
    newRow: { id: "t5", done: false, title: "New" },
  })
  // delta = { viewId: "v1", inserts: [{ id: "t5", ... }], deletes: [], updates: [] }

Zero-Downtime Schema Migrations (Expand/Contract pattern).

Automates the expand-and-contract migration strategy:
1. EXPAND: Add new columns/tables, create dual-write triggers
2. MIGRATE: Backfill data, dual-write during transition
3. CONTRACT: Drop old columns/tables after verification

Defined in: [server/src/workflow/workflow.ts:23](https://github.com/josedab/reactivebase/blob/deadc852d0d384e5f93668842c410b98d14c81d8/packages/server/src/workflow/workflow.ts#L23)

Workflow Orchestration Engine for ReactiveBase.
Defines multi-step, long-running workflows with durable execution.

Features:
  - Step-by-step execution with Postgres-backed checkpointing
  - Automatic resume after server crash
  - Compensation (rollback) on failure
  - Sleep, wait-for-event, and parallel execution primitives
  - Configurable retry/timeout per step

Usage:
  const onboarding = defineWorkflow("user-onboarding", async (wf, { userId }) => {
    const user = await wf.step("fetch-user", () => db.users.get(userId))
    await wf.step("send-email", () => sendWelcomeEmail(user))
    await wf.sleep("cool-down", "24h")
    await wf.step("send-followup", () => sendFollowupEmail(user))
  })

***
